paper.title_en: Holographic Tessellations Tensor Networks $\{p,q\}$ from Entangled Quantum Tetrahedron in Loop Quantum Gravity
paper.abstract_en: The relationship between spin network states in loop quantum gravity and bulk--boundary duality is further explored using the tessellated holographic tensor network. We develop a holographic tensor network construction based on quantum entanglement between tetrahedra in loop quantum gravity (LQG). This construction relates four-valent intertwiner spaces and Bell states dressed with $SU(2)$ holonomies to effective tensors on hyperbolic $\{p,q\}$ tessellations. For the $\{5,4\}$ tessellation, six tetrahedra are assembled into a single effective cell with five network legs and one logical index. Provided that the microscopic transfer map has full row rank, a right inverse and a completion on the kernel space are employed to construct an isometric embedding, yielding an effective tensor proportional to a perfect tensor. The construction is generalized to the $p=2k-1$ family, with local dimensions supporting absolutely maximally entangled states. On finite networks satisfying a radial orientation condition, an appropriate normalization produces an isometric bulk--boundary map. For cuts satisfying the isometry condition on both sides, the boundary entropy decomposes into a link contribution $\sum_{\ell}\log(2j_{\ell}+1)$ and the bulk entropy, thereby providing a discrete realization of the quantum Ryu--Takayanagi structure. Applications to the black hole interior are formulated via postselection-based non-isometric encoding. Assuming additional Haar statistics, this framework is used to analyze the preservation of overlaps on average and the competition between entropy branches underlying the Page Curve. These results establish a constructive link between the geometric degrees of freedom of LQG and holographic codes, while clarifying the conditions required to connect them to geometric area in LQG, the location of the quantum extremal surface, and evaporation of black hole.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在圈量子引力（LQG）框架下构造全息张量网络，将四价 intertwiner 空间与双曲 {p,q} 镶嵌上的有效张量联系起来，并给出等距体-边界映射与边界熵分解，涉及量子 Ryu-Takayanagi 结构、黑洞内部非等距编码及 Page 曲线。其核心是引力量子基础（圈量子引力与全息对偶）的构造性问题，理论上深度较高，适合作为 general_relativity_foundations 主分类，并以黑洞热力学与全息方向为次分类。
decision.title_zh: 来自圈量子引力中纠缠量子四面体的全息镶嵌张量网络 $\{p,q\}$
decision.abstract_zh: 本文利用镶嵌全息张量网络进一步探讨圈量子引力中自旋网络态与体-边界对偶之间的关系。我们基于圈量子引力（LQG）中四面体之间的量子纠缠，发展了一种全息张量网络构造。该构造将四价 intertwiner 空间以及由 $SU(2)$ 完整（holonomy）修饰的 Bell 态，与双曲 $\{p,q\}$ 镶嵌上的有效张量联系起来。对于 $\{5,4\}$ 镶嵌，六个四面体被组装成一个具有五条网络腿和一个逻辑指标的有效元胞。假定微观转移映射具有满行秩，则利用右逆和核空间上的补全来构造等距嵌入，从而得到与完美张量成比例的有效张量。该构造被推广到 $p=2k-1$ 族，其局域维数支持绝对最大纠缠态。在满足径向取向条件的有限网络上，适当的归一化产生等距的体-边界映射。对于两侧均满足等距条件的切割，边界熵分解为链路贡献 $\sum_{\ell}\log(2j_{\ell}+1)$ 与体熵，从而给出量子 Ryu--Takayanagi 结构的一种离散实现。对黑洞内部的应用则通过基于后选择的非等距编码来表述。在额外假定 Haar 统计的情况下，该框架被用于分析平均意义上重叠的保持以及 Page 曲线背后熵分支之间的竞争。这些结果在 LQG 的几何自由度与全息码之间建立了构造性联系，同时澄清了将它们与 LQG 中的几何面积、量子极值面的位置以及黑洞蒸发相联系所需的条件。
